lemma base:
  fixes n :: nat
  shows "(\<Sum>i<0. 2 * i + 1) = (0::nat)^2"

lemma reduction:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator: "0 < b"
  shows "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
lemma root: "sqrt (4::real) = 2"
lemma fact_succ_ne_one: "fact n + 1 \<noteq> (1 :: nat)"

lemma next_sum:
  fixes n :: nat
  shows "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) + (2 * k + 1)"

lemma denominator_nonzero:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator: "0 < b"
  shows "b \<noteq> 0"
lemma rational: "(2::real) \<in> \<rat>"

lemma next_square:
  fixes n :: nat
  shows "\<And>k::nat. k^2 + (2 * k + 1) = (Suc k)^2"

lemma common_positive:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "0 < (gcd a b)"

lemma induction_step:
  fixes n :: nat
  assumes next_sum: "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) + (2 * k + 1)"
    and next_square: "\<And>k::nat. k^2 + (2 * k + 1) = (Suc k)^2"
  shows "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2 \<Longrightarrow> (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (Suc k)^2"

lemma not_both_zero:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"

lemma all_n:
  fixes n :: nat
  assumes base: "(\<Sum>i<0. 2 * i + 1) = (0::nat)^2"
    and induction_step: "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2 \<Longrightarrow> (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (Suc k)^2"
  shows "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2"

lemma numerator_rebuild:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b))"

lemma result:
  fixes n :: nat
  assumes all_n: "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2"
  shows "(\<Sum>i<n. 2 * i + 1) = n^2"

lemma numerator_divides:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "(gcd a b) dvd a"

lemma numerator_cancel:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes numerator_divides: "(gcd a b) dvd a"
  shows "(gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) = a"

lemma denominator_rebuild:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma denominator_divides:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "(gcd a b) dvd b"

lemma denominator_cancel:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_divides: "(gcd a b) dvd b"
  shows "(gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) = b"

lemma reduced_coprime:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma nonzero_pair:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"

lemma cancellation:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes nonzero_pair: "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "coprime (a div gcd a b) (b div gcd a b)"

lemma reduced_square:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes square: "a^2 = n * b^2"
    and reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "(a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma common_nonzero:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "(gcd a b) \<noteq> 0"

lemma common_square_nonzero:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes common_nonzero: "(gcd a b) \<noteq> 0"
  shows "(gcd a b)^2 \<noteq> 0"

lemma numerator_expansion:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "a^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma numerator_factor:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b))"

lemma numerator_power:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "((gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma denominator_expansion:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "b^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma denominator_factor:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma denominator_power:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "((gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma scaled_equality:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes square: "a^2 = n * b^2"
    and numerator_expansion: "a^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2"
    and denominator_expansion: "b^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
  shows "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"

lemma reorder:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2) = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"

lemma cancellable:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes scaled_equality: "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
    and reorder: "n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2) = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
  shows "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"

lemma denominator_one:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
    and reduced_square: "(a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
  shows "(b div (gcd a b)) = 1"

lemma coprime_squares:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) ((b div (gcd a b))^2)"

lemma reduced_pair:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma square_left:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduced_pair: "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma denominator_dvd:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduced_square: "(a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
  shows "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd (a div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma divides_product:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
